notes.subject: ⟨masakɛ bolo⟩
notes.rationale: Heburukan ma kuma min fɔ — Krethiw ni Pelethiw bɛ Benayahu bolo, o ye kɔrɔ-fɔli ye.

notes.subject: כהנים
notes.rationale: Dawid denw ye sarakalasebaga (kohen) ye — KJV ye a fɔ 'chief rulers' ye; Septante fɔ ko 'aatritɔw'; Heburukan kuma ye sarakalasebaga fɔ de.

notes.subject: Krethiw ni Pelethiw
notes.rationale: Ɔrciw tɔgɔw ye crux ye: Crete jamana mɔgɔw, walima masakɛ ka gɛlɛyali-bagaw (boroforyew)?

translation: Benayahu, Yehoyada denkɛ, ani Krethiw ni Pelethiw ⟨masakɛ bolo⟩; Dawid (Dawuda) denw kɛra sarakalasebagaw ye.
